# Itqan

> Itqan is an AI studio for manufacturing, retail and food and beverage. It builds AI agents for operations, supply chain and customer teams, and runs them inside each client's own cloud account (AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud), with the data kept in the client's region and a person approving anything an agent sends. Line: "We build the AI your business runs on, and we stay to run it." Itqan (إتقان) is Arabic for work done properly. Legal entity: Itqan Studio FZ-LLC, Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. The founders work from Dubai and Gothenburg, in Arabic, English and Swedish.

## Team
- Ibrahim Shareef: founder and CEO; engineering, agents and delivery. Dubai. Personal site: https://shareefi.co
- Bisma Aslam: co-founder; design, brand and how the agents write. Gothenburg.

## What Itqan builds
- Agents and workflows: agents that read the inbox, draft the order, answer the store and file the report, with a person approving what goes out.
- Search over your documents: procedures, specs, contracts and past orders, answered in plain language with a link to the page.
- Private models: open-weight models tuned on the client's records and hosted in the client's region, for when a general model is not good enough or not allowed.
- Running it: weekly test runs, model upgrades, a monthly cost ceiling and a written note on the fifth of each month.

## Security
- Deployed in the client's own cloud account; the client holds the keys, the code and the logs.
- Processing in the UAE or the EU when the model allows it; when it does not, the client is told in writing before work starts.
- Only providers and settings that keep client content out of model training.
- Single sign-on and roles, a full audit trail, and a person approving anything that leaves the company.
- Every agent is tested for prompt injection and data leaks before launch and every week after.
- Agents say they are AI when a customer talks to them (EU AI Act Article 50, from 2 August 2026).
- Itqan does not claim an ISO or SOC 2 certification.

## How an engagement runs
1. Briefing: 30 minutes, free, booked at https://itqanstudio.com/book
2. AI Map: one week, $750. The three jobs an agent should take first, the hours each returns, the data each needs and the risks.
3. Pilot: three weeks, one agent on one workflow in the client's cloud, at a fixed price set in the map.
4. Run: monthly, 30 days notice. Code, prompts, test sets and the cloud account belong to the client; on exit everything is handed over within 30 days with no exit fee.
